name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_item_set_selected
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item::SetSelected records selected state, optionally updates default/rollover images, and refreshes the displayed borrowed image when enabled.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C item/table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b8a90 validates the selected write at offset 0x14c, modeOrEnabled early return at offset 0xc4, selected/unselected image pointer choices at offsets 0x16c through 0x178, default/rollover writes at offsets 0xdc and 0xe4, and call to HudUiWidget::SetImageBorrowedAndInvalidate.
The native smoke verifies the disabled early-return path, selected and unselected enabled paths, display image refresh, and option-selector selection flow that calls SetSelected.
